Name: SpaceSwitches
Description: This will add space switches to the target ctrl

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will add space switches to the target ctrl.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetTargetCtrl: set the node/object name this block should use.
- SetAttrsHolder: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Spaces: enter names separated by commas (example format: nameA,nameB,nameC).
- Translate: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Animbot: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Rotate: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- Template target ctrl examples: Tail_1_Main_Ctrl, Eyes_Main_Ctrl, Head_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
